plain_text:
Paul Dubov appears in 159 recordings across 21 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1941 to 1961. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Paul Dubov most often in Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar, Gunsmoke, The Adventures of Frank Race, The Adventures of Philip Marlowe, Fort Laramie, Have Gun, Will Travel, Jeff Regan, Investigator, and Lux Radio Theatre.

Characters credited here include Frank Race and Jeff Regan.
